# Perth Solar Panel Cleaners

> East Perth based solar panel cleaning, gutter cleaning and pigeon proofing service covering the Perth metro area, Western Australia. We use 100% pure filtered water and no chemicals. Free quotes, no travel fees within 40km of East Perth. Phone 0400 369 865.

Key facts:

- Services: solar panel cleaning, gutter cleaning, pigeon and bird proofing under solar panels.
- Method: pure filtered, de-ionised water and soft brushes. No detergents or chemicals.
- Result: regular cleaning can lift solar output by 15–25%.
- How often: once or twice a year for most Perth homes; more often near the coast, bushland, busy roads or lots of birds.
- Price: depends on number of panels, home size and access. Free, no-obligation quotes with a fair upfront price.
- Travel: no travel fees within 40km of East Perth.
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 7am to 6pm.
- Rating: 5.0 from 20+ Google reviews.
- Suburbs: East Perth, Perth CBD, East Victoria Park, Belmont, Cannington, Applecross, Osborne Park, Subiaco, Maylands, Nedlands, Mount Lawley, Bayswater, Bassendean, Morley, Beechboro, Midland, Scarborough, Fremantle, Joondalup, Butler and more.
- Contact: phone or text 0400 369 865, email ross@perthsolarpanelcleaners.com.
- ABN: 28 811 493 909.
